whatIsIt.eli5: One step that makes several piles of notes at once and sends each pile somewhere different.
whatIsIt.simple: A single 1×1 Conv whose output is split into several pieces; each piece is sent to a different place in the second backbone of YOLOv9-E.
whatIsIt.engineer: Conv2d(c1, Σc2s, 1, bias=True) → split(c2s); tuple output.

whyExists.eli5: It lets the first backbone help the second one at many places.
whyExists.simple: YOLOv9-E links two backbones (as in CBNet). CBLinear prepares features from the first backbone for each level of the second.
whyExists.engineer: Composite-backbone linking; part of the YOLOv9-E inference graph in the Ultralytics config.

eli5: Make many piles in one go.
Send each pile to its place.
simple: 1×1 Conv with bias to the total width.

example.simple: YOLOv9-E layer 14 makes pieces of 64, 128, 256, 512 and 1,024 channels: 2,033,600 parameters.
